Reason: The agent (WebSurfer) has already performed the `scroll_down` action three consecutive times (Steps 7, 9, and 11) without any feedback indicating that the link has been found or that the page content has changed. Continuing to scroll repeatedly is inefficient and risks missing the link if it is located in a different section (e.g., a sidebar, a "read more" link, or a separate page) or if the scrolling mechanism has reached the end of the visible content. The agent should pause to verify if the link is present in the current view or consider alternative methods to locate the paper link rather than blindly scrolling again.
